provenance.note: Place name on the river, geocoded to the reach [supplied on this invocation]
Steady upstream CARRIER discharge - the river flow that dilutes and transports the release [supplied on this invocation]
Result-writing cadence; unset keeps the steering file's own period [supplied on this invocation]
Finite pulse injection window [supplied on this invocation]
Point-source discharge of the release itself, small against the river's carrier flow [supplied on this invocation]
Median grain diameter d50 of the RELEASED class - ~200 um fine sand settles within a few km, ~20 um silt mostly stays suspended (all modeled non-cohesive) [supplied on this invocation]
Concentration of the released suspended sediment; what deposits is measured against what this put in [supplied on this invocation]
Modeled reach length downstream of the release; a longer reach is coarsened under the mesh node budget [supplied on this invocation]
Simulated physical time [supplied on this invocation]
Target element edge length the reach is triangulated at; peak concentration is a resolution-bound class and a coarse mesh reads it low [supplied on this invocation]
Solve sizing class [declared constant default]
Along-reach release position, 0=upstream..1=downstream; the source must sit strictly INSIDE the reach, never on a boundary [declared scenario default]
Sustained wind driving a surface wind-stress term; 0 = no wind [declared scenario default]
Compass bearing the wind blows FROM (0=N, 90=E); only read when wind_speed_mps > 0 [declared scenario default]

The mass the pulse released - source_q_m3s x sediment_concentration_mgl x spill_duration_s - which the deposited fraction is measured against [derived by trid3nt_server.workflows.telemac.templates.river_sediment_plume.injected_mass.injected_mass_kg]

not supplied; the coefficient is read as a Strickler one
